dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Jets (3-8) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Dolphins
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Aaron Glenn and the medical staff evaluate WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle), WR Isaiah Williams (ribs), LB Trevin Wallace (groin), and DT Harrison Phillips (ankle) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report. DT David Onyemata (abdomen (surgery)) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [newyorkjets.com Official](https://www.newyorkjets.com/news/geno-smith-focused-on-fast-start-four-quarter-effort-vs-dolphins-11-25-2026).

Week 12 Dolphins Outlook: Aaron Glenn and DC Brian Duker open installation for the Miami Dolphins (1-9, NYJ -3.5, HC Jeff Hafley, OC Bobby Slowik & DC Sean Duggan (Road Test))—a unit ranked #2 in Rush EPA Allowed / Gm (-1.82) as New York prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [newyorkjets.com Official](https://www.newyorkjets.com/news/geno-smith-focused-on-fast-start-four-quarter-effort-vs-dolphins-11-25-2026) [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-preview-2026-new-york-jets-vs-miami-dolphins).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-8 (3rd in AFC East • #12 Seed in AFC), New York carries a 1% postseason projection, 0% AFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/jets-designate-dt-tvondre-sweat-for-return).

Around the Beat: After missing four games with a knee injury, Jets defensive tackle T’Vondre Sweat returned to practice on Wednesday, the team announced [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/jets-designate-dt-tvondre-sweat-for-return).
